purpose: Metadata for external validation of the frozen LSA-ConvTok Hybrid model. Stores slide-level species annotations, C. albicans morphology subgroups, expected slide counts, descriptive acquisition-protocol metadata, the optical acquisition primitives (optics), and validation rules. external_manifest.py uses it to assign labels; optics_provenance.py derives all optical geometry from the optics block.

external.header_source: imagej_unit_XResolution (verified across 24 external slides, shape 2256x2256, isotropic)

training.header_source: imagej_unit_XResolution (verified across 60 internal slides, shape 1200x1200, isotropic)

notes: Only physical primitives are stored. Pixel spacing, field of view, network-input spacing, decimation factors and cross-domain ratios are derived at runtime by optics_provenance.py and checked against header_pixel_spacing_um (rule O-3) and per-image TIFF calibration (rule O-4).

External 2x2 reduction (4512 -> 2256 px) is confirmed; whether it was hardware binning or digital subsampling/averaging is not encoded in the TIFF header (binning_mode = unknown, logged as a provenance gap under rule O-6).

Header values were verified by the author from imagej_unit_XResolution tags (geometry_spec.json audit of 60 internal and 24 external TIFFs). Theoretical values: external 137/1575 um/px, training 11/63 um/px.

external_acquisition_metadata.sample_preparation: Agar pad technique with 1.7% agarose and 5 µL culture.
external_acquisition_metadata.sampling_strategy: Images acquired from random areas of each slide; approximately 62 images per slide; focus manually optimized per slide and then kept constant.

training_domain_reference.purpose: Stored only to document the acquisition-domain shift relative to the training domain. It must not be used to normalize external raw TIFF values. Optical geometry lives in the optics block.

quality_control_notes: Use slide_id as the independent biological/acquisition unit for primary statistics.
Use image-level metrics only as descriptive secondary analyses.
Do not infer or modify hyphae status from model predictions.
Slide identifiers are preserved exactly as provided by the laboratory/user and should be matched literally against the raw filenames.
Acquisition date is confounded with species (all C. glabrata slides on 20260507; 10/12 C. albicans slides on 20260508). Report this as a limitation.
Slide 20200528_alb_A carries a 2020 date while the cohort was acquired in May 2026; verify against the TIFF DateTime tag and lab records (PARTIAL).

amendments.change: Post hoc physical-scale resampling sensitivity analysis retired; stored pixel spacings and spacing ratios removed; optics block (schema 2.0) introduced.
amendments.reason: The external pixel spacing previously recorded was the unbinned sensor value applied to 2x2-reduced images (off by a factor of about 2.02); the analysis therefore did not test what it claimed. True spacings are now derived from physical primitives and verified against header calibration.

amendments.change: Photometric mean/std sensitivity analysis recorded as post hoc.
amendments.reason: It was added after the primary locked result was observed; it is diagnostic only.
